NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Clean interface
patches.description: Customizes Home, navigation, account and search surfaces, and optional rating prompts.

options.title: Hide home search bar
options.description: Hides Home search unless single-page simplification keeps native search visible.

options.title: Hide Featured tab
options.description: Hides the Featured / For You tab from the home tab bar.

options.title: Hide Plaza tab
options.description: Hides the Plaza / Channel tab from the home tab bar.

options.title: Hide Campaign and Activity tabs
options.description: Hides promotional, event, and activity tabs (e.g. Dapatkan Itabag, Gratis Sementara, limited-time events).

options.title: Hide Subscriptions tab
options.description: Hides the Subscriptions tab from the home tab bar.

options.title: Hide Anime tab
options.description: Hides the Anime tab from the home tab bar.

options.title: Hide Home Shorts tab
options.description: Hides the Shorts tab from the home tab bar.

options.title: Hide Community (Opus) tab
options.description: Hides the Community (Opus) tab from the home tab bar.

options.title: Simplify single-page Home
options.description: Shows native search and hides the tab row when Home has exactly one installed page.

options.title: Hide Discover tab
options.description: Hides the Discover tab from the bottom navigation bar.

options.title: Hide Create button (+)
options.description: Hides the center Create (+) button from the bottom navigation bar.

options.title: Hide Chats tab
options.description: Hides the Chats (Messages) tab from the bottom navigation bar.

options.title: Hide Me tab
options.description: Hides the Me (Profile) tab from the bottom navigation bar.

options.title: Hide bottom Shorts tab
options.description: Hides the Shorts tab from the bottom navigation bar if present.

options.title: Hide Creator Center
options.description: Hides the Creator Center dashboard card and banner buttons.

options.title: Hide Campaign menu
options.description: Hides promotional/campaign menus.

options.title: Hide FAQs menu
options.description: Hides Help & FAQs menus.

options.title: Hide Feedback menu
options.description: Hides Feedback and report menus.

options.title: Hide search trending searches
options.description: Hides trending search hot words and suppresses the network request.

options.title: Hide discovery modules
options.description: Hides discovery section modules, tabs, and dividers on the search landing page.

options.title: Clean search bar hint
options.description: Neutralizes promotional default keywords and forces the default 'Search' hint.

options.title: Hide discover tabs
options.description: Hides the sliding tab strip and ViewPager2 content on the Discover page.

options.title: Hide Discover trending searches
options.description: Hides trending searches and suppresses loading spinner on the Discover page.

options.title: Disable rating prompts
options.description: Disables unsolicited app rating dialogs.

patches.name: Clean player
patches.description: Hides selected player branding, recommendations, outro cards and optional comments and danmaku.

options.title: Disable player watermark
options.description: Hides the top-right brand logo and copyright/premium watermark in the video player.

options.title: Disable player recommendation widget
options.description: Disables fullscreen video player bottom-right recommendation widget.

options.title: Disable player outro unlock card
options.description: Disables video player outro unlock video guide bottom-right card.

options.title: Hide user interactions
options.description: Hides player comments and danmaku, disables danmaku sending, and preserves subtitle settings.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Disables internal Bilibili telemetry, APM profiling, TradPlus ad mediation, Firebase analytics, Crashlytics, and Facebook AppEvents.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Uses Morphe GmsCore for Google sign-in and sign-out.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides selected feed, splash, floating, push, overlay and under-player advertisements.

options.title: Hide question cards
options.description: Also hides feed interest and rating questionnaires.

options.title: Hide feed ads
options.description: Hides feed advertisement cards and optionally interest and rating questions.

options.title: Disable floating ads
options.description: Disables bottom-right promotional floating advertisement overlay.

options.title: Disable inner push banner
options.description: Disables top slide-down promotional toast and inner-push banner notifications.

options.title: Disable splash ads
options.description: Disables cold-start splash advertisement loading and countdown timer.

options.title: Disable player overlay ads
options.description: Disables video player in-stream bottom-right overlay ad banners.

options.title: Disable under-player ads
options.description: Disables direct and SDK advertisements below the player while preserving access prompts.

patches.name: Remove user content
patches.description: Filters known user videos and creator surfaces, keeps Anime search, and preserves unknown official content and download management.
